commands: pnpm pack --pack-destination <system-temp> for each checked-in extension package with a tracked main entry, then tar -xzf <fresh-archive>

gate_input_derivation.git_tracked_production_sources: Normalize git ls-files paths to repository-relative forward-slash form; read tracked Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, protobuf, and JSON production surfaces under crates/, packages/, and extensions/ plus root package.json; run the test-owned carrier/root/manual-geometry/synthetic/ordinal/public-override classifiers over their current bytes.
gate_input_derivation.cargo_package_graph: Parse the full all-features Cargo metadata package and resolve graphs; require every workspace_members ID to have one package, one dependency-graph node with resolved features, and non-empty targets; require every target src_path to be tracked; classify the tracked tree rooted at every workspace package plus every feature-relevant target source.
gate_input_derivation.pnpm_package_graph: Parse pnpm-workspace.yaml globs to derive the expected workspace package directories, require exact equality with the repository-local package paths returned by pnpm list -r --depth Infinity --json, consume repository-local production/optional dependency edges, recursively inspect main/module/types/bin/exports entry points from every root/workspace package.json, and classify the tracked package trees and tracked entry points.
gate_input_derivation.extension_manifests: Independently discover tracked package.json files carrying both publisher and engines.vscode, then classify each manifest and its tracked package surface, including the five package-target scripts in packages/vue-vscode/package.json.
gate_input_derivation.ci_release_steps: Read every tracked .github/workflows/*.yml or *.yaml file; select complete steps whose name/uses denotes cp, copy, mv, package, stage, upload-artifact, or download-artifact; extract referenced crates/, packages/, extensions/, and root package.json production paths from the whole step body; classify the referenced tracked paths.
gate_input_derivation.generated_binding_manifests: Parse every out directory in buf.gen.yaml and require root package.json proto:gen to invoke buf generate; parse packages/native/package.json as the NAPI binding manifest and follow its main entry; classify the tracked generated output trees and generated native loader entry.
gate_input_derivation.unpacked_shipping_artifacts: Independently discover checked-in extension package manifests with a tracked main entry; create a unique system-temp directory, run pnpm pack, freshly unpack the resulting tgz with tar, require the unpacked main bytes to equal the tracked shipping surface, classify that unpacked entry under its normalized repository identity, and remove the temp directory without caching repository output.
gate_input_derivation.normalization_and_equality: For every input, intersect its independently selected path surface with the same path/symbol classifier, fail if any mandated input contributes zero identities, union all normalized repository-relative (path,symbol) sets, and exact-compare the sorted union with classified ledger rows plus the empty explicit allowlist. Ledger rows are never read by discovery.

aggregation_policy.named_definitions: function/type-level: a separately named scanner, parser, manual-geometry helper, override surface, or mandatory seed gets its exact symbol
aggregation_policy.lsp_named_consumers: path-level: each path matching scan_sfc_blocks|SfcBlock|CustomBlockContentKind|find_balanced_close_tag|outer_template_content_span|find_close_tag_name gets one legacy_sfc_geometry_consumer row, or legacy_sfc_geometry_test_support for test/support paths; independently named manual helpers on that path remain additional function-level rows
aggregation_policy.path_level_families: one row per path per matched capability family for projections, generated bindings, synthetic-source/artifact builders, ordinal DTO surfaces, packaging manifests, and checked-in shipped bundles
aggregation_policy.multi_capability_paths: a path matching distinct capability families has one row for each family; repeated matches inside one path/family collapse to one identity
aggregation_policy.shipping_targets: one row per declared VSIX target because each target is an independently shipped artifact
aggregation_policy.gate_reproduction: crates/verter_session/tests/cases/scanners_replacement.rs executes every gate_input_derivation procedure above, asserts each recorded per-input count, rejects zero contribution from any class, and exact-compares the sorted union without using rows as discovery input

discovery.revalidation: gate-time live derivation replaces reliance on retained r1 graph inventories; every run consumes the current tracked tree, package graphs, manifests, workflows, generated surfaces, and a newly packed/unpacked shipping artifact

set_equality.proof: sorted independently discovered (path,symbol) identities equal sorted ledger identities; discovery inputs are never the ledger
